'''Dom''', also known as '''Bruiser''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of [[Excelsior Company]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] served as the [[Company/Legends|company's]] demolitions expert.<ref name="Lost Legion" />
